content.narrative_hook: The ridge trail connects the diggings to the township — a narrow track worn by thousands of boots carrying picks and hope.

beats.text: The trail winds along the cliff edge. Below you, a hundred claims stretch across the valley like open wounds.
Every few paces, a stake marks someone's boundary — fresh wood or rotting, depending on how long they've lasted.
A windlass creaks somewhere below. The sound carries across the diggings like a heartbeat.

neutral.text: You reach the township edge, your boots heavy with red earth.
